sources.citation: Pelkey, Jamin R. 2011. A Phula Comparative Lexicon: Phola, Phuza, Muji, Phowa, Azha. SIL Language and Culture Documentation and Description 18. sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent: syllable template {(C)(V)VT}; 'Suprasegmentally Hlepho features four contrastive tonemes: high-level /55/, mid-level /33/, low-rising /13/ and low-falling /21/' plus sandhi rules and citation-form realizations of /21/; the words stress/accent occur 0 times in the whole book.
